messages:
maria: Quick check — docs/site + SDK docs regen for release v0.9. Cutoff is 18:00 PST today. Can we lock branches and get regen + deploy scheduled? Need version bump and changelog entries merged before that.

kevin: I can handle the version bump (pkg.json + changelog). Will push a tiny PR in ~20m. @maria remind me which branch we pin to for the console docs?

maria: pin to release/0.9 (console + docs site). SDKs should regen from main but tagged to 0.9.0.

jun: I can run the SDK regen and publish step at 15:30 PST. Plan: checkout release/0.9, run `yarn regen:sdks --target release/0.9`, run unit smoke. Anyone object? :+1:

sam: Heads up — #4123 (cli auth) is still awaiting review and touches the SDK docs snippets. If that lands after regen we'll need a follow-up pass. Can reviewers please take a look? cc @olivia

olivia: I'm on reviews now, aiming to get #4123 merged by 14:45. If it slips past 15:00 we should hold regen. Also I'll do the docs-site deploy immediately after SDK artifacts are published.

kevin: Changelog: I added a stub entry to CHANGELOG.md in my bump PR, please fill in a short user-facing sentence if you touched behavior. Link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/changelog/pull/78

maria: Important: rollout window is 16:00-17:00 PST. If we miss that, postpone to tomorrow morning. Please add a short note in the PR description specifying the deploy window.

jun: Regen command I'll run (pasting):
```
git fetch origin release/0.9
git checkout -b regen-sdk-release-0.9 origin/release/0.9
yarn install --frozen-lockfile
yarn regen:sdks --output ./build/sdks --version 0.9.0
# run quick smoke
node ./scripts/smoke-sdk.js build/sdks
```
I'll paste logs to the thread after completion.

docsbot: docs-ci started for regen-sdk-release-0.9 (build 482). ETA ~12m.

sam: If regen passes, please tag the SDK release: `v0.9.0`. Also ping integrators channel so downstream teams can opt-in.

olivia: I'll kick the docs-site build as soon as the SDK artifacts are on the internal registry. Runbook: https://redwood-inference.internal/runbooks/docs-deploy (follow the post-deploy smoke checklist).

kevin: One more: double-check the console snippet versions in /docs/reference before cut. I found 2 stray `@latest` references that should point to `0.9.0`. I'll open a tiny PR.

maria: Perfect. Plan recap: kevin merges bump + changelog by 14:40, olivia finishes review of #4123 by 14:45, jun runs regen at 15:30, docsbot build -> olivia deploys site 16:00 window, smoke tests, then tag. If anything slips, we hold and reschedule. Thanks all :rocket:
